_note: Hand-written cook builds. Every build flips what its champion is known for (Nico, 2026-10-16: keep only builds like Melee Bomb Man Ziggs). build_data.py adds augment text, China win rates and simulator numbers and writes data.js. The first `core` augments decide the build's tier; the rest are flex picks. `augment_text` replaces the generated text for augments whose tooltip numbers the game data doesn't fill in.

augment_text.With Haste: Gain Move Speed equal to a share of your Ability Haste.

builds.title: Melee Bomb Man
builds.why: Ziggs gives up his bombs-from-a-mile-away identity and walks up to stab people. Draw Your Sword turns his range into AD, Health, Attack Speed and Lifesteal, and his passive Short Fuse still blows up on his next melee hit. Dual Wield, Firebrand and Juiced pile on-hit magic damage onto every swing.
builds.play: Walk at them. Throw a bomb only when you're already standing on them.

builds.title: Noxian Sniper
builds.why: The reverse of Melee Bomb Man. Melee champions get more from the range augments than ranged ones (75, 150 and 250), so all three together add 475 range and put Darius's autos at 650, the same as Caitlyn's. He stacks Hemorrhage from across the fight, and Typhoon fires a second shot at another target.
builds.play: Stand at the back and auto. Walk up only to Guillotine whoever has five stacks.

builds.title: Tiny Marksman
builds.why: Veigar's whole game is stacking infinite Ability Power. escAPADe turns every point of it into 0.6 bonus AD (plus 15% more AD), so his Q stacks and even Rabadon's Deathcap now feed his auto attacks. Dual Wield, Critical Rhythm and It's Critical make him a crit marksman with a yordle hat.
builds.play: Farm Q stacks like normal, then right-click everyone. Cage still works.

builds.title: Grounded
builds.why: Kayle spends the early game as a weak melee champion waiting to ascend into a ranged carry. Draw Your Sword sets her to melee range for good, which should keep her from ever getting the range, and pays her back with AD, Health, Attack Speed and Lifesteal. Goliath and Heavy Hitter turn the angel into a giant frontline bruiser.
builds.play: Skip the ascension. Walk in front and hit things with your sword.

builds.title: Long-Range Siphon
builds.why: Siphoning Strike is an empowered auto attack, and the three Scope augments give a melee champion 475 range, so Nasus stacks Q from 600 range. Stackosaurus Rex doubles every stack he earns. The dog farms from across the lane like a marksman.
builds.play: Last-hit every minion with Q from max range. Walk up only when the stacks are big.

builds.title: Rocket Spammer
builds.why: Jinx is an attack speed marksman, and Purist - Caster converts all of her Attack Speed into Ability Haste (0.65 per 1%). Her minigun stacks and Get Excited's huge Attack Speed burst become haste, so she stops attacking fast and spams Zap!, Chompers and Super Mega Death Rocket instead.
builds.play: Get a takedown, then spam W and R while Get Excited lasts.

builds.title: Grandmaster Mage
builds.why: The reverse of Tiny Marksman. ADAPt turns every point of Jax's bonus AD into 1.67 AP, so his BotRK and Rageblade become mage items, and Marksmage adds a share of that AP to every auto. W, E and R scale with AP, so the lamp post becomes a magic staff.
builds.play: Build like an AD Jax, play like an AP Jax. Hop on the carry and empower everything.
